Unplanned downtime is expensive — and often avoidable. 📋 Preventative maintenance helps identify developing issues before they turn into a shutdown: blocked filters, leaking ductwork, worn fans and deteriorating airflow can all affect extraction effectiveness long before a failure happens. A routine inspection from Burwell Environmental Division helps you understand your equipment's condition and prioritise maintenance before it becomes a problem. Book a preventative maintenance inspection. #PreventativeMaintenance #UnplannedDowntime #BurwellEnvironmental #IndustrialMaintenance #SystemPerformance
